reviewBasis: Compared correction wording with documented scope gaps. Source PDF was not re-read in this pass.

rows.gap: The draft locates the parathyroids. Clarify whether the brief description should also cover basic gland anatomy.
rows.proposal: Briefly describe the parathyroid glands, covering usual number and location alongside the existing thyroid anatomy scope.
rows.suggestedRefinement: Include a brief description of gland morphology alongside usual number and location.

rows.gap: The draft covers extent, relations and branches. It omits the explicitly listed formation of the chain.
rows.proposal: Explicitly include formation of the cervical sympathetic chain alongside extent, relations and branches.

rows.gap: Tonsillar bed and vascular relations are covered. Explicit palatine tonsil morphology and applied anatomy are missing.
rows.proposal: Explicitly cover morphology and applied anatomy of the palatine tonsil alongside its relations and blood supply.

rows.gap: Fibre orientation, relations, innervation and actions are covered. Muscle position is not explicit.
rows.proposal: Explicitly identify the positions of semispinalis capitis and splenius capitis.

rows.gap: The draft mentions pulse locations generically. Specify palpation of the carotid, facial and superficial temporal arteries.
rows.proposal: Specify palpation of the carotid, facial and superficial temporal arteries.

rows.gap: Explicit identification of the external parts is missing from the cross-sectional task.
rows.proposal: Identify the external parts alongside internal components, blood supply and lymphatic drainage.

rows.gap: The draft omits the explicitly listed course of the vessels.
rows.proposal: Explicitly trace the course of the portal vein, inferior vena cava and renal veins.

rows.gap: The draft identifies the anastomoses but omits their applied anatomy and correlations.
rows.proposal: Relate the major portosystemic anastomoses to their applied anatomy and clinical correlations.

rows.gap: The draft maps pontine cranial nerve nuclei by level and modality. It limits the scope to major nuclei, while the source does not specify that limit.
rows.proposal: Map pontine cranial nerve nuclei and their functional groups without limiting the task to a major-nuclei subset.

rows.gap: The task maps neural tube regions and vesicles to later structures. It does not explicitly address formation of the neural tube itself.
rows.proposal: Describe formation of the neural tube before tracing development of the spinal cord, brainstem, cerebral hemispheres and cerebellum.

rows.gap: The draft covers synapses and myelin. It does not explicitly cover the wider ultrastructure of neurons and supporting glia.
rows.proposal: Cover representative neuronal and glial ultrastructure alongside synaptic and myelin organization.

rows.gap: The draft contrasts polymorphism with disease-associated variation. Explicitly cover mutation as a source of variation across pathogenicity categories.
rows.proposal: Cover mutation as a source of genetic variation across pathogenicity categories.

rows.gap: The draft depicts the structures but leaves their formation implicit.
rows.proposal: Describe formation of each listed embryonic structure alongside its diagram.

rows.gap: NMC competency lists the four joints to describe, while the draft adds a comparison of stabilizers and movements as required assessed detail.
rows.proposal: Describe all four source-listed joints. Keep comparative stabilizers and movements outside the required scope unless separately supported.

rows.gap: NMC explicitly requires type, articular surfaces and movements of four joints; the draft also assesses stabilizers without a dedicated source-bound objective.
rows.proposal: Require joint type, articular surfaces and movements for the four listed joints. Treat stabilizers as supplementary.

rows.gap: The task names limitations generally. Explicitly distinguish disadvantages of the procedure from limitations of the resulting test.
rows.proposal: Explicitly address procedural disadvantages of amniocentesis alongside test limitations.

rows.gap: The task names limitations generally. Explicitly cover disadvantages of chorionic villus sampling.
rows.proposal: Explicitly address procedural disadvantages of chorionic villus sampling alongside test limitations.

rows.gap: The label and task say 'pectoral muscles' without restricting the scope to the specific named pair in the 2024 NMC task.
rows.proposal: Describe attachments, nerve supply and actions of pectoralis major and pectoralis minor; describe the clavipectoral fascia.

rows.gap: The draft explicitly adds innervation as a tested attribute. The official row specifies muscle attachment, action and clinical anatomy rather than nerve supply as a stated outcome.
rows.proposal: On a specimen or model, describe and demonstrate serratus anterior attachments and actions, and explain relevant clinical anatomy.

rows.gap: The draft requires comparison of two venous patterns, while the source objective only establishes the anatomical basis of elbow venipuncture.
rows.proposal: Describe the anatomical basis of cubital venipuncture, including relevant superficial venous location and neighbouring structures in a labelled diagram.
